A daughter was born to Elrine Lindford and Kalan Wexwood, and they called the child Illis Wexwood. The family lived in Wendwick.
Kavus Dornwood gave Coten Stenick a solemn promise to plant an orchard on the slope above Quenby.
act: to plant an orchard on the slope above Quenby

text: Before the winter was out, Nyvus Ashner took Gaena in marriage at Larkton. The couple lived in Larkton from then on.
Davus Stenick left Wilby and settled in Kelmere.
Rilis went along to live in Kelmere as well.
Talia won the silver dagger from Vorald Dornwood at cards, fairly, and kept it.
Vorald Dornwood packed a single trunk and moved from Coldmere to Kelmere.
Tavie Stenick followed him to Kelmere within the month.
The eldest son of Orra Ashner whispered that Comira Lindford had secretly married Isbin Stenick, but nobody could say where or when.
Nyvus swore to Gavus to repair the roof of the chapel at Gulby, and shook on it.
act: to repair the roof of the chapel at Gulby

text: Neten found work in Kelgate, moved there, and did not return to Gulby.
Peten gave up idleness and took work as a shepherd.
Late one night Illan Grimaby confided to Nelia Tallowaby that the old abbey at Larkton hides a second cellar.
Orlde Prydmere whispered that Nylis Wexwood had secretly married Uldrek Thornaby, but nobody could say where or when.
A daughter was born to Gaena Tallowaby and Nyvus Ashner, and they called the child Rolde Ashner. The family lived in Larkton.
Nyvus rode out of Larkton; by the next market day he was living in Salwick.
Gaena Tallowaby followed him to Salwick within the month.
Gaena Tallowaby swore to Nyvus to teach the children of Wendcombe their letters, and shook on it.
act: to teach the children of Wendcombe their letters

text: Gossip from the wife of Uldrek Thornaby claimed Vorald Wexwood and Riwyn Lindford had been wed in secret.
Dadrek Thornaby won the glass flute from Nyvus at cards, fairly, and kept it.
After the quarrel, Feten Tallowaby quit Elmhaven for good and took lodgings in Wendwick.
Brelia Ashner went along to live in Wendwick as well.
Davus Stenick sent the brass comb by carrier to the youngest daughter of Malis Wexwood, who received it safely.
A parcel from Dadrek Thornaby reached Rolan Ashner; inside was the glass flute, now his to keep.
A son was born to Vovie Wexwood and Kavus Dornwood, and they called the child Ellan Dornwood. The family lived in Gulstead.
True to her word to Nyvus Ashner, Gaena Tallowaby finished what she had promised (teach the children of Wendcombe their letters).
Isbin could keep it no longer and told Darine that the deed to the Quenby pastures was forged.
That winter, a wound that festered took Neten Tallowaby; he was buried at Kelgate.
Wedan Dornwood died of a fall from the mill loft at Elmhaven.
cause: a fall from the mill loft

text: In a letter that the eldest son of Bressa Marrner burned after reading, Brelia Ashner revealed that the harbor master of Fenholt takes bribes.
Rolan Ashner meant to go to Wendcombe before the frost, but the roads flooded and the journey was put off.
Elrine Lindford gave up idleness and took work as a miller.
Rilis Wexwood gave birth to a daughter, named Rorine Stenick; the father was Davus Stenick. The family lived in Kelmere.
Wenar Stenick left Mireford and settled in Wendcombe.
Vesena Stenick went along to live in Wendcombe as well.
Talia Stenick left Coldmere and settled in Wendcombe.
Thidan Thornaby followed her to Wendcombe within the month.
In the chapel at Elmhaven, Ronelle married Illan. The couple lived in Elmhaven from then on.
Illan Grimaby swore to Ronelle Dornwood to rebuild the fallen wall at Larkton, and shook on it.
act: to rebuild the fallen wall at Larkton

text: In a letter that the husband of Zara Lindford burned after reading, Vorald Wexwood revealed that the fire at the Wendwick granary was set on purpose.
A parcel from Ganelle Wexwood reached Dadrek Thornaby; inside was the pewter flute, now his to keep.
Dadrek was apprenticed anew and became a ferryman.
In a letter that Brerine Marrner burned after reading, Ulena Thornaby revealed that the old abbey at Larkton hides a second cellar.
Before the summer was out, Rolan Ashner took Brerine in marriage at Wendwick. The couple lived in Wendwick from then on.
Rolan Ashner gave the glass flute to Hanar Marrner.
A daughter was born to Elrine Lindford and Kalan Wexwood, and they called the child Yeena Wexwood. The family lived in Wendwick.
That summer, drowning in the flood took Illan Grimaby; he was buried at Elmhaven.
Zanar Marrner could keep it no longer and told Brerine Marrner that the fire at the Wendwick granary was set on purpose.
Brelia Ashner kept the promise made to Darine Ashner: the task (rebuild the fallen wall at Dunford) was done by harvest.
Before the summer was out, Dadrek Thornaby took Ronelle Dornwood in marriage at Salwick. The couple lived in Salwick from then on.
A son was born to Talia Stenick and Thidan Thornaby, and they called the child Vesdan Thornaby. The family lived in Wendcombe.
In the chapel at Wilby, Jorine Stenick married Vorald Wexwood. The couple lived in Wilby from then on.
A daughter was born to Rilis Wexwood and Davus Stenick, and they called the child Riena Stenick. The family lived in Kelmere.
Gadette Thornaby packed a single trunk and moved from Kelmere to Elmhaven.
Elnar Marrner went along to live in Elmhaven as well.
Peten Thornaby could keep it no longer and told Zara that the old abbey at Larkton hides a second cellar.
Gavus won the brass comb from Ganelle at cards, fairly, and kept it.
Nyvus Ashner died of drowning in the flood at Salwick.
In a letter that Vorald Wexwood burned after reading, Darine Ashner revealed that the deed to the Quenby pastures was forged.
Red Gavus never did keep the promise made to Nyvus Ashner (plant an orchard on the slope above Gulstead); the matter was abandoned.
Ganelle Wexwood gave Gavus Tallowaby a solemn promise to carry a sealed letter to Wilby.
act: to carry a sealed letter to Wilby

text: Talia meant to go to Elmhaven before the frost, but the roads flooded and the journey was put off.
True to her word to Gavus Tallowaby, Ganelle finished what she had promised (carry a sealed letter to Wilby).
The husband of Elrine Lindford could keep it no longer and told Zara Lindford that the harbor master of Fenholt takes bribes.
Kalan Stenick won the bone compass from Orlde Prydmere at cards, fairly, and kept it.
Zara Lindford could keep it no longer and told Zanar Marrner that the harbor master of Fenholt takes bribes.
The husband of Brerine Marrner rode out of Wendwick; by the next market day he was living in Quenby.
Brerine Marrner went along to live in Quenby as well.
Davus Stenick never did keep the promise made to Brelia Ashner (repair the roof of the chapel at Mireford); the matter was abandoned.
